presentation.summary: Plan and execute a critical mobile-crane lift beside operating plant while managing load data, rigging, exclusion zones and worsening wind.
presentation.role: You are the lifting safety lead supporting a mobile-crane critical lift beside live process equipment.
presentation.situation: A vessel spool must be lifted through a constrained operating area. The job depends on accurate load information, rigging integrity, exclusion control, weather limits and disciplined stop-work decisions.
presentation.objective: Complete the lift without exposing people or plant to suspended-load, rigging or loss-of-control hazards.
knownFacts: The lift is close to operating equipment.
The spool geometry can create load-control challenges.
The access route is used by other contractors.
Wind can affect the long load during movement.

lift_plan_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: This is professionally plausible and partly correct, but it leaves one material criterion unresolved compared with the BEST action.

lift_plan_decision_weak.observable: Preparation or work continues while a significant control question remains unresolved at the verify the critical-lift basis stage. The available recovery margin decreases.
lift_plan_decision_weak.guidedInsight: The action contains a valid element, but sequencing is weak because work advances before the decisive safeguard has been verified.

lift_plan_decision_critical.observable: The critical lift proceeds on an unsupported assumption at the verify the critical-lift basis stage. A critical safeguard is bypassed and risk escalates sharply.
lift_plan_decision_critical.guidedInsight: A critical choice often sounds efficient because it relies on prior status, appearance or experience. High-hazard work requires positive verification of the critical barrier.

exclusion_decision_best.guidedInsight: The BEST option closes the important uncertainty before work proceeds. It controls the hazard through verification rather than assumption.

exclusion_decision_critical.observable: The critical lift proceeds on an unsupported assumption at the protect the lifting route stage. A critical safeguard is bypassed and risk escalates sharply.
exclusion_decision_critical.guidedInsight: A critical choice often sounds efficient because it relies on prior status, appearance or experience. High-hazard work requires positive verification of the critical barrier.

wind_decision_best.observable: The team stops or stabilizes the work when conditions change at the respond to loss of load control stage. The new condition is verified before the task continues.
wind_decision_best.guidedInsight: Changing conditions invalidate earlier assumptions. The BEST response creates a deliberate hold point and reassesses the controls before exposure continues.

wind_decision_defensible.observable: The team pauses part of the activity and gathers more information, but some exposure or uncertainty remains during the respond to loss of load control stage.
wind_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: This choice recognizes the change, yet it leaves a narrower safety margin than a full stop-and-reassess response.

wind_decision_weak.observable: The work continues under modified monitoring or local precautions even though the respond to loss of load control condition has changed materially. Risk begins to rise.
wind_decision_weak.guidedInsight: Extra observation is not equivalent to restoring a failed or uncertain barrier. Changed conditions should be controlled, not merely watched.

wind_decision_critical.observable: The changed condition is effectively accepted and the critical lift continues. A critical barrier is lost and the scenario moves into emergency territory.
wind_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Proceeding because an alarm limit, schedule or visible condition has not yet become extreme can miss the earlier point where safe intervention was still easy.

closeout_decision_defensible.observable: The team strengthens the immediate controls and uses a controlled restart review, but the closeout does not explore the underlying failure as completely as the BEST path.
closeout_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: Corrective action is valuable, but restart assurance is stronger when the underlying cause and all affected safeguards are verified.

closeout_decision_weak.observable: The team corrects the most visible problem and prepares to resume the critical lift before the full causal chain has been resolved.
closeout_decision_weak.guidedInsight: A technically acceptable local fix can still be weak if it restores production before learning and system-level corrections are complete.

closeout_decision_critical.observable: The critical lift is pushed toward restart after only superficial recovery. Critical causes or damaged safeguards remain unresolved.
closeout_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Restart pressure can recreate the same hazard. A major event is more likely when work resumes before critical barriers are restored and verified.

closeout_decision_best.observable: The critical lift remains suspended while causes, damaged safeguards and corrective actions are verified. Work is reauthorized only after a safe basis is re-established.
closeout_decision_best.guidedInsight: Safe closeout is not simply returning conditions to normal. It must address why control was lost and verify the barriers needed for a safe restart.

safe_completion.title: Safe completion
safe_completion.narrative: The critical lift was completed with the critical hazards controlled and changing conditions managed before escalation.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: You kept the lift inside verified engineering, rigging and environmental limits.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: The critical lift developed a significant control weakness, but later decisions restored a controlled state before serious harm occurred.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: A weakness appeared, but the lift was paused and recovered before it became an incident.

incident_contained.title: Incident contained
incident_contained.narrative: The scenario developed into an incident, but emergency and recovery actions contained the event and limited its consequences.
incident_contained.keyTurningPoint: The load-control event occurred, but exclusion and recovery measures limited harm.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control failures allowed the critical lift to escalate into a major incident requiring extended response, investigation and corrective action.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Multiple lifting safeguards degraded and the suspended-load hazard escalated.

critical_failure.title: Critical failure
critical_failure.narrative: The decision path produced a severe uncontrolled outcome in the critical lift. Recovery options were overwhelmed by a critical barrier failure.
critical_failure.keyTurningPoint: A critical lifting control was overridden when the load was no longer demonstrably controlled.
